Conditional constructs

The if command tests commands and executes the corresponding consequent commands. Optional clauses are shown in square brackets. The manual uses preformatted examples with variable elements rather than nested code elements.

if test-commands; then
  consequent-commands;
[elif more-test-commands; then
  more-consequents;]
[else alternate-consequents;]
fi

A pipeline is a sequence of one or more commands separated by a control operator. The following syntax shows optional timing and negation before the first command, followed by additional pipeline commands.

[time [-p]] [!] command1 [ | or |& command2 ] ...
